arxiv-2111-04395.title: Seeding crystallization in time
arxiv-2111-04395.creator: Michal Hajdušek, Parvinder Solanki, Rosario Fazio, Sai Vinjanampathy
arxiv-2111-04395.description: Abstract We introduce the concept of seeding of crystallization in time by studying the dynamics of an ensemble of coupled continuous time crystals. We demonstrate that a single subsystem in a broken-symmetry phase acting as a nucleation center may induce time-translation symmetry breaking across the entire ensemble.

arxiv-2112-05306.title: Eigenfunction and eigenmode-spacing statistics in chaotic photonic crystal graphs
arxiv-2112-05306.creator: Shukai Ma, Thomas M. Antonsen, Steven M. Anlage
arxiv-2112-05306.description: Abstract The statistical properties of wave chaotic systems of varying dimensionalities and realizations have been studied extensively. These systems are commonly characterized by the statistics of the eigenmode-spacings and the statistics of the eigenfunctions. Here, we propose photonic crystal (PC) defect waveguide graphs as a new physical setting for chaotic graph studies.

arxiv-2204-13787.title: Nonlinear Addition of Qubit States Using Entangled Quaternionic Powers of Single-Qubit Gates
arxiv-2204-13787.creator: Dominic Widdows
arxiv-2204-13787.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel way to use the algebra of unit quaternions to express arbitrary roots or fractional powers of single-qubit gates, and to use such fractional powers as generators for algebras that combine these fractional input signals, behaving as a kind of nonlinear addition. The method works by connecting several well-known equivalences.

arxiv-2206-13244.title: Using the Jacobi-Trudi Formula to compute Stirling Determinants
arxiv-2206-13244.creator: Tewodros Amdeberhan and Shalosh B. Ekhad
arxiv-2206-13244.description: Abstract Classification: 05A10, 05A15, 05E05, 11B65 PART I: Theory The unsigned Stirling numbers of the first kind \left[{n\atop k}\right] enumerate permutations of n elements with k disjoint cycles. They also arise as coefficients of the rising factorial, i.e., x(x+1)(x+2)\cdots(x+n-1)=\sum_{k=0}^{n}\left[{n\atop k}\right]x^{k}.

arxiv-2207-11935.title: Hunting Quantum Gravity with Analogs: the case of High Energy Particle Physics
arxiv-2207-11935.creator: Paolo Castorina, Alfredo Iorio, Helmut Satz
arxiv-2207-11935.description: Abstract In this review we collect, for the first time in one paper, old and new results and future perspectives of the research line that uses hadron production, in high-energy scattering processes, to experimentally probe fundamental questions of quantum gravity.

arxiv-2210-17267.title: A Monte Carlo algorithm to measure probabilities of rare events in cluster-cluster aggregation Journal: Computer Physics Communications
arxiv-2210-17267.creator: Rahul Dandekar, R. Rajesh, V. Subashri, Oleg Zaboronski
arxiv-2210-17267.description: Abstract We develop a biased Monte Carlo algorithm to measure probabilities of rare events in cluster-cluster aggregation for arbitrary collision kernels. Given a trajectory with a fixed number of collisions, the algorithm modifies both the waiting times between collisions, as well as the sequence of collisions, using local moves.

arxiv-2401-12790.title: MORPH : Towards Automated Concept Drift Adaptation for Malware Detection
arxiv-2401-12790.creator: Md Tanvirul Alam, Romy Fieblinger, Ashim Mahara, and Nidhi Rastogi
arxiv-2401-12790.description: Abstract Concept drift is a significant challenge for malware detection, as the performance of trained machine learning models degrades over time, rendering them impractical. While prior research in malware concept drift adaptation has primarily focused on active learning, which involves selecting representative samples to update the model, self-training has emerged as a promising approach to mitigate concept drift.

arxiv-2404-11848.title: Partial Large Kernel CNNs for Efficient Super-Resolution
arxiv-2404-11848.creator: Dongheon Lee, Seokju Yun, Youngmin Ro
arxiv-2404-11848.description: Abstract Recently, in the super-resolution (SR) domain, transformers have outperformed CNNs with fewer FLOPs and fewer parameters since they can deal with long-range dependency and adaptively adjust weights based on instance. In this paper, we demonstrate that CNNs, although less focused on in the current SR domain, surpass Transformers in direct efficiency measures.

arxiv-2410-09118.title: FSW-GNN: A Bi-Lipschitz WL-Equivalent Graph Neural Network
arxiv-2410-09118.creator: Yonatan Sverdlov, Yair Davidson, Nadav Dym, Tal Amir
arxiv-2410-09118.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yonatan Sverdlov, Yair Davidson, Nadav Dym, Tal Amir. Famously, the ability of Message Passing Neural Networks (MPNN) to distinguish between graphs is limited to graphs separable by the Weisfeiler-Lemann (WL) graph isomorphism test, and the strongest MPNNs, in terms of separation power, are WL-equivalent. However, it was demonstrated that the quality of separation provided by standard WL-equivalent MPNN can be very low, resulting in WL-separable graphs being mapped to very similar, hardly distinguishable outputs.

arxiv-2507-11860.title: Planar Turán number of quasi-double stars
arxiv-2507-11860.creator: Huiqing LIU, Tian XIE, Qin ZHAO
arxiv-2507-11860.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Huiqing LIU, Tian XIE, Qin ZHAO. Given a graph H H , we call a graph H H -free if it does not contain H H as a subgraph. The planar Turán number of a graph H H , denoted by ex 𝒫 ⁡ ( n , H ) \ex_{\mathcal{P}}(n,H) , is the maximum number of edges in a planar H H -free graph on n n vertices.

arxiv-2507-18359.title: Variational determination of minimal absorbing zones in incompressible shear flows
arxiv-2507-18359.creator: Péter Tamás Nagy 1
arxiv-2507-18359.description: Abstract The dynamical analysis of shear flows remains challenging, as turbulence generation and evolution are not fully understood. Here, a lesser-explored feature of incompressible shear flows-the “absorbing zone”- is investigated. This region in the infinite dimensional state space is shown to act as an attractor for all trajectories: any solution initialised outside eventually enters and remains inside.

arxiv-2601-03268.title: WRAVAL – WRiting Assist eVALuation
arxiv-2601-03268.creator: Gabriel Benedict, Matthew Butler, Naved Merchant, Eetu Salama-Laine
arxiv-2601-03268.description: Abstract The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) has shifted language model evaluation toward reasoning and problem-solving tasks as measures of general intelligence. Small Language Models (SLMs) – defined here as models under 10B parameters – typically score 3-4 times lower than LLMs on these metrics.

britannica-1911-canonization.title: Canonization (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-canonization.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-canonization.description: Article 'Canonization' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 5), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Christian Church the ecclesiastical authority grants to a deceased believer the honour of public cultus. In the early Church there was no formal canonization. The cultus applied at first to local martyrs, and it was only in exceptional circumstances that a kind of judiciary inquiry and express decision became necessary to legitimate this cultus.

pmc-10880851.title: Extensive Pulmonary Cryptococcosis as a Presentation in an Immunocompetent Young Male: A Fluorodeoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography/Computed Tomography Finding
pmc-10880851.creator: Prajwal Chauhan, Vijay Singh, Sumeet Kumar De, Mansi Gupta, Alok Nath, Manish Ora
pmc-10880851.description: A 42-year-old male presented with a dry cough, breathlessness, and fever. He underwent a computed tomography that revealed large consolidation in the right lung. Biopsy revealed Cryptococcus neoformans. He was on antifungal for 4 months with no clinicoradiological improvement. 18F- fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography/computed tomography (18F-FDG PET/CT) showed consolidations in the right lung with multiple lung nodules.

pmc-11320220.title: Preliminary experience of surgery after neoadjuvant immunotherapy combined with chemotherapy for stage-IIIB non-small cell lung cancer
pmc-11320220.creator: Yizong Ding, Xiaojing Zhao, Petros Christopoulos, Travis C. Geraci, Yujie Fu
pmc-11320220.description: BackgroundPreviously, stage-IIIB non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) has been considered inoperable. In recent years, neoadjuvant immunotherapy has shown encouraging efficacy in the treatment of advanced stage NSCLC in several trials. However, the effectiveness and safety of neoadjuvant immunotherapy in treating stage-IIIB NSCLC are still unknown.

pmc-11403936.title: HIV testing among female sex workers and associated factors in Burkina Faso: findings from a respondent-driven sampling survey
pmc-11403936.creator: Kadari Cisse, Henri Gautier Ouedraogo, Odette Ky-zerbo, Dinanibè Kambire, Sylvie Zida, Célestine Ki-toe, Solange Dioma, Désiré Lucien Dahourou, Fatou Sissoko, Alexandre Yugbare, Abdoul Aziz Ouedraogo, Abdoul Ibrahim Ouedraogo, Smaila Ouedraogo, Seni Kouanda
pmc-11403936.description: BackgroundIn Burkina Faso, only 70% of people living with HIV knew their status in 2018, while the first 95 target of the UNAIDS suggests that by 2025 at least 95% of people living with HIV (PLHIV) know their HIV status.

pmc-11692932.title: TRAJECTORIES OF FALLS AND ASSOCIATED FACTORS AMONG ADULTS 65 AND OLDER: INSIGHTS FROM THE HEALTH AND RETIREMENT STUDY
pmc-11692932.creator: Rohit Baal Balasundaram, Brittany Krenek-Schneider, Edna Patricia Mendoza, Anup Dharmendrakumar Patel, Lien Quach, Uyen-Sa Nguyen
pmc-11692932.description: Falls are the leading cause of injuries among older adults in the United States, with over 14 million older adults, or 1 in 4, reporting a fall each year. This longitudinal prospective cohort study investigated fall trajectories and associated risk factors in people with no prior history of falls.

pmc-12410610.title: Practice of oxygenation and respiratory support during fibreoptic bronchoscopy: the OxyFOB study protocol
pmc-12410610.creator: Federico Longhini, Claudia Crimi, Alberto Noto, Corrado Pelaia, Zuhal Karakurt, Szymon Skoczyński, José Pedro Boléo-Tomé, João Carlos Winck, Antonio M Esquinas, James Melhorn, Dan Corneci, Pavol Pobeha, Vincenzo Bosco, Eugenio Garofalo, Andrea Bruni, Gianmaria Cammarota, Violeta Todorova, Mariangela
pmc-12410610.description: IntroductionFlexible bronchoscopy (FB) is widely used for diagnostic and therapeutic procedures in pulmonary medicine. However, FB can cause respiratory and haemodynamic complications, especially in patients with pre-existing lung and/or cardiovascular comorbidities. Despite the range of oxygenation and ventilatory approaches available to prevent these risks, evidence regarding their real-world application and clinical impact is limited.

pmc-12495341.title: A combined modelling approach to predicting injury severity in rear-end collisions
pmc-12495341.creator: Shufeng Wang, Shixuan Jiang, Zhengli Wang, Lingyi Meng
pmc-12495341.description: Rear-end collisions constitute the most prevalent category of urban road traffic accidents, resulting in severe traffic congestion, casualties, and substantial economic losses. To mitigate the impact of such accidents effectively, this study proposes a severity prediction model that integrates Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost). The model employs the U.S.

pmc-12573603.title: Colletotrichum tofieldiae enhances phosphorus uptake and biomass production and alters the microbial interactions in the rhizosphere of komatsuna (Brassica rapa var. perviridis) grown in phosphorus-deficient farm soils
pmc-12573603.creator: Elsie Sarkodee-Addo, Yasuhiro Tsujimoto, Aung Zaw Oo, Tomohiro Nishigaki, Kei Hiruma, Papa Saliou Sarr
pmc-12573603.description: Microbial bioinoculants should play important roles to achieve sustainable phosphorus (P) management in agriculture. Colletotrichum tofieldiae (Ct), a fungal endophyte, is a promising material that supports phosphorus acquisition in Arabidopsis under low phosphorus (P) conditions and promotes maize and tomato growth in a greenhouse.

pmc-12698858.title: Geolocated Lightning Network topology snapshots: A dataset covering 2019–2023
pmc-12698858.creator: Danila Valko, Jorge Marx Gómez
pmc-12698858.description: The Lightning Network (LN) is the most widely adopted second-layer solution for Bitcoin, enabling fast, low-cost transactions through a decentralized payment channel network. Despite its growing importance and the increasing interest from researchers across disciplines, progress in LN research is often impeded by limited access to structured, validated, and reproducible network data.

pmc-12744870.title: Targeting Metal Ion Homeostasis for Regulated Cell Death-Amplified Tumor Nanomedicine
pmc-12744870.creator: Qiqing Chen, Kun Li, Jinzhuo Li, Xue Liu, Jiaxin Li, Lianuang Xu, Yabing Han, Ting Zou, Xingrong Wang, Yangcheng Yao, Yuhang Mao
pmc-12744870.description: Amidst escalating global health challenges, neoplastic diseases remain a predominant cause of morbidity and mortality, exerting complex and far-reaching effects on human health and societal well-being. The advent of precision medicine has ushered in an era of tailored therapeutic strategies, leveraging individual genetic profiles, tumor microenvironmental features, and exogenous factors to redefine oncology care.

pmc-13283284.title: Biased and inflexible interpretations of social situations predict depressive symptoms and relational outcomes in parent-adolescent dyads
pmc-13283284.creator: Reuma Gadassi-Polack, Reut Zabag, Michael V Bronstein, Jutta Joormann, Jonas Everaert
pmc-13283284.description: Adolescence is a critical period for social-emotional development, characterized by increased risk for psychopathology and disruptive changes in the parent-adolescent relationship. Biased and inflexible interpretations of social situations have been linked to psychopathology and adaptive social functioning, but these associations are rarely studied in adolescence.

pmc-13333330.title: A Rapid Genotyping Assay for FTO and PPAR-γ Nutrigenetic Variants in Thai Adults with Overweight/Obesity
pmc-13333330.creator: Sakawrut Poosri, Usa Boonyuen, Pattaneeya Prangthip
pmc-13333330.description: BackgroundNutrigenetic research linking fat mass and obesity-associated (FTO) and peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPAR-γ) variants to dietary response and obesity risk requires accessible genotyping tools, particularly for population studies in low- and middle-income countries. Current genotyping methods are typically limited to single or duplex formats, increasing cost and processing time for multivariant screening.

pmc-13357462.title: Quantitative bone SPECT/CT-derived tumor burden as a prognostic biomarker in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer treated with Ra-223
pmc-13357462.creator: Yoshimitsu Fukushima, Go Kimura, Jun Akatsuka, Yoshimitsu Honda, Yujiro Nakaoka, Hiromitsu Hayashi, Shinichiro Kumita
pmc-13357462.description: PurposeMetastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) is bone-predominant, requiring objective imaging biomarkers to guide Ra-223 therapy. We evaluated overall metabolic bone volume (OMBV) and overall total bone uptake (OTBU) from bone SPECT/CT as prognostic markers in mCRPC patients treated with Ra-223.MethodsThirty mCRPC patients underwent pre-treatment planar and SPECT/CT bone scintigraphy, with OMBV and OTBU derived using GI-BONE software.

pmc-13381384.title: Epidemiological characterization of uveitis in the elderly population: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13381384.creator: Tom Liba, Eran Levanon, Alon Gorenshtein, Jacob Megreli, Gil Ben-David, Itamar Gothelf, Asaf Bar, Rita Ehrlich
pmc-13381384.description: PurposeThis systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to characterize etiological patterns of uveitis in individuals aged 60 years or older.MethodsFollowing the PRISMA 2020 and MOOSE reporting guidelines, we searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, PubMed Central (PMC), and Web of Science (January 1, 2005–January 1, 2025). Data extraction focused on study characteristics, sample size, uveitis location, and reported causes.

pmc-13389713.title: Communication features of ChatGPT responses and care-seeking intention for syphilis in Japan: a controlled dialogue experiment
pmc-13389713.creator: Fuka Nagano, Emi Furukawa, Shinya Ito
pmc-13389713.description: Objective: Syphilis is a major re-emerging infectious disease, and pre-consultation support may be particularly important in rural and remote areas where access to confidential care is limited and stigma can delay help-seeking. We examined how communication features in ChatGPT-generated responses influence perceived consultation satisfaction and intention to seek professional care in a simulated syphilis-related anxiety scenario in Japan.

pmc-6441206.creator: Mou Y, Wang J, Wu J et al.
pmc-6441206.description: Peer-reviewed research article (PubMed Central). Ferroptosis is a novel type of cell death with distinct properties and recognizing functions involved in physical conditions or various diseases including cancers.
